meta_description: Homeworks is your trusted painter and decorator in Southampton. Interior and exterior painting, property maintenance. Free quotes. Call 07884 467523.
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior painting done right. From feature walls to full property refreshes, we transform Southampton homes with precision and care.
services_subhead: From interior redecoration to exterior repainting and property maintenance, we handle every job with professionalism and attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Transform your rooms with expert interior painting. We prep surfaces properly, apply premium finishes, and protect your furnishings throughout. Feature walls, full room refreshes, and specialist finishes available.

services.title: Exterior House Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior paint work that lasts. We prepare all surfaces, apply undercoat and topcoat, and use quality masonry paint suited to Southampton's coastal climate.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, window frames, and built-in joinery painted to a high standard. We use specialist paints for durability and deliver a finish that's both smooth and hard-wearing.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Removal
services.desc: Professional wallpaper fitting and removal. We match patterns, cut cleanly, and ensure every seam is invisible. Removal services tackle even stubborn paper without damage to plaster.

services.title: Property Maintenance & Touch-Ups
services.desc: Keep your property looking fresh with regular maintenance visits. Caulking, minor repairs, touch-ups, and seasonal refreshes keep wear and tear at bay.

services.title: Commercial Painting & Redecorating
services.desc: Fast, efficient painting for retail, office, and hospitality spaces. We work around your opening hours and minimise disruption whilst delivering professional, durable results.

about_pullquote: We paint homes the way we'd want ours painted—with real care and no cutting corners.
about_para_1: Homeworks was founded over two decades ago by a painter frustrated with the shortcuts he saw on job sites across Southampton. What began as a one-man operation has grown into a trusted team, but our values haven't changed. We still turn up on time, still protect your home like it's our own, and still deliver finishes that last.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on repeat customers and personal recommendation. Southampton families know that when Homeworks is booked in, the job will be done properly—no faffing about, no surprise bills, and a result you'll be proud of. We're insured, reliable, and we take pride in leaving your home looking better than we found it.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Homeworks

reviews.text: Had the lounge done top to bottom and it looks absolutely pristine. The lads were tidy, professional, and finished exactly when they said they would. They even cleaned up after themselves properly, which you don't always get. Really pleased with the job and the price was fair. Will definitely use Homeworks again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Needed the exterior of the house refreshed before selling. Contacted Homeworks for a quote and they came out within two days, no pressure, gave me a fixed price. The painters were great—early every morning, worked through, and left the place spotless. Sold the house two weeks later. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend them.
reviews.author: Linda W.

reviews.text: Our kitchen needed redecorating and we were worried about disruption. The team came in, did the job brilliantly, and we were only out of action for three days. Attention to detail is excellent—no drips, no mess, everything masked off properly. Really impressed. Fair price too.
reviews.author: Robert S.

address_sub: Serving Southampton, Netley, Totton, Bitterne, Shirley, and surrounding areas
emergency_banner_text: Need a quick paint refresh or maintenance work? Call us now for a free quote and honest advice —
footer_description: Homeworks is a family-run painting and decorating business serving Southampton for over 20 years. Interior, exterior, and property maintenance with a reputation for quality and reliability.
